name: reload-mark
about: P7 reload trigger, measured: does an edited mod script take effect on a level load in the same session, or only after a restart? mods/gamelab-reload logs MARK from its module constructor; the scenario rewrites MARK A -> B while in town, loads a mission level, and records which mark the new level's constructor prints. Measured 20261017-144040: the mission level printed mark=A, so a level load does not recompile from disk; the restart step (a new game process) prints B.

steps.name: MARK edited to B while the game runs
a level load keeps the old script (mark A): no hot reload
restart: quit and boot a new game process
after a restart the edit is live (mark B)
